description: Convert sky coordinates between equatorial (J2000, of date), ecliptic, galactic and horizontal (alt-az) frames. E.g. {frame: 'equatorial_j2000', coordinates: {ra_hours: 6.7525, dec: -16.7161}, datetime: '2026-06-21T21:00:00Z', latitude: 48.8566, longitude: 2.3522}. For catalogues, planetarium and telescope software: give a direction in one frame and get it in all the others: equatorial J2000 (ICRS) and of date, ecliptic J2000 and of date, galactic, and horizontal (altitude, azimuth) when a datetime and a place are given. Geometric frame rotations of a direction (no aberration or refraction is added: use astronomy/altaz for where a body appears). Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/convert (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.
